newsitem.title: USA: TCI preliminary Q4 oper cash flow $598 mln.
newsitem.headline: TCI preliminary Q4 oper cash flow $598 mln.

text.p: TCI Communications Inc said Monday that its preliminary fourth quarter operating cash flow was $598 million before restructuring charges.
Restructuring charges were $36 million, including $27 million for work force reduction and $9 million for consolidating accounting activities, the company said.
The company said its year-ago operating cash flow was $502 million.

It said its fourth quarter revenues were $1.620 billion compared to $1.315 billion a year-ago. Revenue from acquisitions, net of dispositions, represented about $177 million, and excluding their impact, fourth quarter revenues grew $128 million, the company said.
The company said it would file its final financial results by March 31.

TCI, a subsidiary of Tele-Communications Inc, attributed its year-over-year revenue growth in to a June rate increase, modest internal customer growth, advertising revenues heightened by the 1996 presidential campaign and increased pay-per-view revenue from a November boxing match.
